home.trust1Text: Since 2009, we have delivered engineering and contracting projects in the healthcare, hotel and railway sectors. Our work includes the CCHF Proton Therapy Building in Cairo, and ergonomic control room furniture and general furniture for the NCC Monorail and the West Nile Monorail.
home.trust2Text: Our team covers architectural, interior design, structural, mechanical, electrical and landscape design, together with general contracting, fit out and furniture. One company takes your project from design through to completion.
home.trust3Text: The Citadels is owned and run by the founding Mazhar family, and we work with honesty, reliability and fairness. We take on medium to large projects, apply a selective risk management process to every new project, and deliver on our promises.
home.ctaP: Contact our team to discuss furniture solutions for your home, hotel, office, or specialized project. We respond to all inquiries within one business day.
home.projectsLead: From proton therapy facilities to monorail control rooms, we deliver furniture solutions for environments where quality is not optional.

home.aboutHeading: A Family-Owned Company With a Proven Track Record
home.aboutP1: Founded in 2009, The Citadels Company is a family-owned company with a proven track-record of excellence in Engineering and Contracting of projects in Healthcare, Hotels and Railway sectors.

about.heroLead: The Citadels is a family-owned company with a proven track record in engineering, contracting, fit-out, and furniture solutions across Egypt.
about.storyP1: Founded in 2009, The Citadels Company is a family-owned company with a proven track-record of excellence in Engineering and Contracting of projects in Healthcare, Hotels and Railway sectors.
about.storyP2: Our established contacts in Egypt, our highly skilled and dedicated team, our innovative methods and quality standards for completion made us a competitive partner and well recognized in the industry.
about.storyP3: The founding Mazhar family still own and run the business, and the family values of honesty, reliability and fairness are the way we offer to our customers.
about.visionText: Our vision is to be the leading Engineering, Construction, Fit out and Furniture services company in Egypt, in a reliable execution, cost effectiveness, and Highest-class technical recognition.
about.missionText: We are committed to differentiating ourselves by continuously increasing ourexpertise in executing medium scale to large projects while maintaining a highlyselective risk management process for every new project and venture. Our success comes from our people, who strive to continuously innovate, adapt tolocal markets and hone their skills. The Citadels will continue to grow and increase profitability.
about.val1Text: We only work with manufacturers and partners whose products meet international standards of durability, safety, and design.
about.val2Text: We honor commitments on timelines, specifications, and budgets. Our clients depend on us for projects with strict deadlines.
about.val3Text: As a family-owned company, our name is on every project. We operate with transparency and take personal responsibility for outcomes.
about.val4Text: We work with clients as long-term partners, providing ongoing support well beyond the initial delivery and installation.
about.sec1Text: Specialized furniture for hospitals, clinics, proton therapy centers, and laboratory environments.
about.sec2Text: Control room consoles, station furniture, and ergonomic operator workstations for monorail and rail systems.
about.sec3Text: Guest room furniture, lobby seating, restaurant furnishings, and conference room solutions for hotels.
about.sec4Text: Executive furniture, modular workstations, and ergonomic solutions from leading international office brands.
about.sec5Text: Premium furniture for living rooms, bedrooms, dining areas, and private villas.
about.sec6Text: Seating, check-in counters, and gate area equipment designed for high-traffic aviation environments.
about.ctaText: Whether you are furnishing a single office or outfitting an entire facility, our team is ready to help.

partnerDetail.ctaText: Get in touch with The Citadels team and we will provide a detailed proposal including product specifications, pricing, and delivery timelines for your project.
partnerDetail.ableIntro: Able is the largest Furniture Manufacturer and Brand specializing in contemporary furniture design in Eastern Europe — with more than 30 years of experience and a reflection of the best of Albania.
partnerDetail.ableP2: We offer the design and architecture community our acquired design and manufacturing expertise to create bespoke fully furnished (turnkey) projects for the global contract and high-end Hotels, Residential and Commercial market.
partnerDetail.ableP3: Our commitment to quality, durability, and design excellence has made us a trusted partner for numerous hospitality projects worldwide.
partnerDetail.ableP4: Please take your time to visit the ABLE website to familiarize yourself with the full range of products. Alongside well-known brands, you can also find in the PDFs local completed projects with 5-star credentials — Hospitality highlights showcased mainly for clients to see the quality of work and our dedication to meeting their requirements.
partnerDetail.zivellaIntro: Since 1999, Zivella has been bringing an innovative approach to workspaces with a team of over 200 people, aiming to make life at work healthier, happier, and more efficient.
partnerDetail.zivellaP2: Zivella's collection features contemporary office chairs, modular seating systems, ergonomic executive desks, and flexible meeting solutions designed by acclaimed international designers.
partnerDetail.zivellaP3: Operating from their state-of-the-art production facility in Istanbul, Zivella combines advanced manufacturing technology with skilled craftsmanship to produce durable and aesthetically pleasing office environments.
partnerDetail.zivellaP4: The brand is committed to sustainability and human-centric design, creating pieces that adapt to modern agile working methods while supporting employee wellbeing.
partnerDetail.falmarIntro: Born in Treviso, one of the most culturally active and economically dynamic areas of Italy, Falmar combines artisan mastery with continuous technological innovation.
partnerDetail.falmarP2: Falmar is renowned for its specialized partition wall systems—including single-pane glass, double-pane acoustic glass, and solid modular panels—that redefine spatial organization in modern offices.
partnerDetail.falmarP3: Their product portfolio extends to sophisticated executive desks, operational workstations, and bespoke storage solutions, all characterized by the unmistakable elegance of Italian design.
partnerDetail.falmarP4: By integrating acoustic engineering and architectural flexibility, Falmar provides environments that balance open-plan collaboration with the need for privacy and concentration.
partnerDetail.boscoIntro: BOSCO is a pioneer in designing and delivering high-tech control room solutions — providing iconic, ergonomic consoles and video wall systems built for the most demanding 24/7 environments.
partnerDetail.boscoP2: Built with exceptional durability and resistance, their command-and-control centres combine cutting-edge functionality with timeless design. Based in Italy, BOSCO has delivered control rooms in more than 20 countries — spanning Europe, Africa, the Middle East, South America, and West Asia.
partnerDetail.boscoP3: With over 30 years of experience, they have partnered with prestigious clients across multiple critical sectors: Oil and Gas, Power Plants, Military and Defence, Aviation and Transport, Security and Surveillance, and Smart Cities.
partnerDetail.boscoP4: Their expertise ensures that human operators can maintain focus and efficiency during long shifts, through carefully calculated viewing angles, adjustable desk heights, and integrated environmental controls.
partnerDetail.boscoIndVal: Oil & Gas, Power, Military, Aviation, Smart Cities
